rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Answering in the House of Representatives Special Committee on Disasters on 24 August 1993, the Director-General of the National Land Agency (上原康助), who had introduced himself as appointed on 9 August, states that the Hosokawa cabinet came into being on 9 August (八月九日に細川内閣が誕生).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the same answer the minister (上原康助) says that when the Hosokawa cabinet came into being on 9 August (八月九日に細川内閣が誕生をいたしまして) he received the Prime Minister's special instruction (特命) to deal quickly with the Kagoshima heavy-rain disaster.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Questioning the minister in the same sitting, member 宮路和明 says that on the 13th Prime Minister Hosokawa (細川総理) himself entered the Kagoshima disaster area, and the minister's answer confirms that the Prime Minister went to Kagoshima on the 13th.
